strategy: re-adjudicate the accepted candidate with tooluse_resolution advisory
advisory_rationale: R-F4257 established that this axis measures a configuration that never ships. Production resolves company identity deterministically (resolve_company_search), hands the model the RESOLVED company rather than a candidate list (format_for_prompt), and REPLACES the model's answer when identity is gated (enforce_resolution_response, R-F4144) — on both the chat and streaming surfaces, with a replace event correcting already-streamed text, pinned in CI by test_rf4144. The 168-row eval carries none of it: 0 of 168 rows hold the gate marker and the pod evaluator never imports companies_house. Both failure shapes the axis measures are therefore structurally impossible in the shipped path. Operator decision 2026-08-23 after 13 candidates and arms, none of which exceeded the SFT parent's 13/16. ADVISORY MEANS MEASURED AND REPORTED, NOT DROPPED: the regression is still computed and still appears in every verdict.
reversal_condition: If enforce_resolution_response is ever removed from a response path, or the eval adopts the production identity gate, this axis becomes load-bearing again and must be restored to blocking. test_rf4144 and test_rf4257 both fail loudly if that happens.
what_this_promotion_is: The candidate becomes the accepted PARENT/incumbent for future training cycles. It does NOT deploy to production: ARIA-LLM is not wired into the live chain (ARIA_LLM_URL unset, CLAUDE.md section 16) and Phase A gates remain open.
